periods.time: Post-war guard service and graduation trip
periods.label: Cheerful member of the Three Harmonies
periods.summary: Cheerful Three Harmonies member who keeps Lux relaxed. During the graduation trip she drunkenly admits she would accept even concubine status if it meant being with him, then tries to preserve the line of friendship.

lux-arcadia.summary: Affectionately calls him little Lux and wants to stay near him as guard.

key_events.summary: Tours Rairel Town with Lux and the other guards, then helps care for him after he overheats in the bath.
Captures the defeated Hounds leader with EX Land Drag-Ride wires.
